hardwareHubs.note: The University of Nevada, Reno Innevation Center houses a makerspace with CNC machines and 3D printing.
UNLV runs a Digital Fabrication Lab with laser cutting, 3D printing and CNC cutting.

makerspaces.name: Makerspace at the UNR Innevation Center
makerspaces.note: Lists CNC machines, a manual mill and lathe, 3D printing and an embroidery machine.

makerspaces.name: UNLV Digital Fabrication Lab
makerspaces.note: A search listing shows a CNC router, laser cutter and Bambu Lab 3D printers.

programs.name: Innevation Center
programs.note: University of Nevada, Reno center whose makerspace serves members, students and the community with a prototyping machine shop and 3D printing.

specialties.name: Advanced manufacturing
specialties.note: The state's economic development office lists advanced manufacturing as a target industry with e-mobility, clean technologies and aerospace and defense sub-sectors.

specialties.name: Tahoe-Reno Industrial Center
specialties.note: The governor names the center as home to Tesla, Panasonic and Redwood Materials investments.

support.name: Manufacture Nevada
support.note: NIST MEP center for Nevada, listed by NIST under this name.
